svg.title: Graph of g
svg.desc: Coordinate graph of g showing a straight left branch, a curved right branch, an open point at (3, 4), and an isolated filled point at (3, 6). For x < 3 the graph follows y = x + 1. For x > 3 it follows y = −(x − 3)² + 4. The point (3, 4) is open and (3, 6) is filled. Arrows indicate continuation beyond the displayed window.
